title: Bitwise OR of Even Numbers in an Array
summary: Given an integer array, compute the bitwise OR of all even numbers within it.
statement: Given an integer array, compute the bitwise OR of all even numbers within it. Return 0 if no even numbers are present.
constraints: Select only even values from nums.
Return zero when no even value exists.
hints: Inspect every value and retain only evens.
OR each retained value into the accumulator.
If none qualify, the untouched identity supplies the required zero.
editorial: If none qualify, the untouched identity supplies the required zero.

tests.explanation: The even values 2, 4, and 6 have bitwise OR six.
No even values exist, so return zero.
